**Planning formula parser**

I'm thinking about implementing a robust JavaScript formula parser. It needs to include features like tokenization and a recursive descent parser, and support functions and ranges. For the UI, I’ll make div cells where users can input formulas directly. I want to ensure there’s a focus on typing the formula easily, but inserting formula references when clicking on grid cells could be a tricky part to figure out. I've got a lot to create here!
